entities.summary: The Battle of Kizaki (木崎原の戦い) occurred on the 4th day of the fifth month of Genki 3 when the forces of Shimazu Yoshihiro defeated the larger army of Itō Yoshisuke. The battle, also known as "The Okehazama of Kyushu".
